text:
Just like in previous days, I am posting the tools used and the final prompt.  

As always, two Nano Banana Pro keyframes; seedance censored the "grass plantation" in the background, as the output wasn't dynamic enough. The ever-increasing censorship on almost all platforms hinders the creative process. 

Ultimately, I animated both keyframes in Grok @imagine  

Here is the prompt:

Cinematic 10-second video, one single unbroken side-scrolling tracking shot (smooth continuous lateral camera glide left to right, no cuts, no jumps).

Exact character reference (highest priority):

Use 379bb4f0-76c1-439c-9bce-24a19e6671cd _1 as the absolute opening frame AND strict character identity reference. The y00ts character must stay 100% identical in every frame: exact same beanie, same sunglasses, same puffer jacket, same fur tone and texture, same facial structure, same body proportions and style. Zero identity drift allowed.

Camera & Movement:

Steady professional lateral tracking shot. Full body always visible from the side. Character walks confidently with energetic, fluid stride and natural arm swing, matching upbeat 120+ BPM energy. At 8.8 seconds the character slows smoothly, turns slightly toward camera, kneels gracefully and reaches hand down to touch the grass. Camera gently pushes in toward the hand and holds on the exact final composition of reference 8e6ee2bb-c190-4032-a514-bdbfc4ed9475 image_2 until the end.

Seamless Environment Progression (morning → golden hour):

Environments transform fluidly and cinematically around the continuously walking character:

0.0s: Misty forest — cool blue-grey dawn, dense fog between tall trees, damp forest floor (exact opening reference)

1.25s: Stream landscape — fresh cool morning light, mossy rocks, flowing water beside the path

2.5s: Cherry blossom alley — soft warm morning light, pale pink petals gently drifting down

3.75s: Mountain summit — crisp air, vast dramatic horizon and open sky

5.0s: Forest path — midday, warm dappled sunlight filtering through leaves

6.25s: Open meadow — warm afternoon sun, tall grass swaying gently

7.5s: Sunflower field — late afternoon, saturated golden sunlight, flowers at eye level

8.75s: Lavender field — golden amber light, dense purple rows stretching to horizon, gentle breeze

10.0s: Coastal cliff — golden hour, dramatic ocean and sky behind, character kneeling and touching grass (exact closing reference)

Mood & Lighting: Freedom through nature. A streetwear y00ts character completely at home in the wild. Cool morning energy slowly builds into warm, liberating golden hour release. Natural light progression from cool blue-grey to warm golden tones.

Style: Cinematic naturalism, 35mm film aesthetic, shallow depth of field, beautiful natural colors, organic feel, photorealistic yet true to the stylized y00ts character. Extremely high coherence and stability.

Sound Design: Upbeat organic electronic track at 120+ BPM with punchy rhythm and natural textures (birds, wind, rustling leaves, water). Beat drops align with each environment change. Last 1.5 seconds: music softens gently as the character touches the grass, ending on one beautiful held note.

Technical Quality:

Perfect anatomy, smooth fluid motion, no jitter, no flickering, no distortion, no stretching, no ghosting, no bent limbs, sharp clarity, natural motion blur, maximum stability and detail.

I extended the finished video using the following prompt.

The character slowly rises slightly from the kneel, turns fully toward the camera, looks straight into the lens with confident motivational energy. He raises his right arm and points directly forward at the viewer with his index finger while speaking.

He says clearly with perfect lip-sync and strong, empowering voice: “Don’t forget to touch grass and develop new ideas on weekend!”

As always, the compositing was done in AfterFX for the time-ramping and the addition of sound.
content:
Use two keyframes (start and end) as strict references: set the opening frame as absolute character identity reference and the closing frame as the exact final composition to hold on at the end.  
Prevent identity drift by explicitly prioritizing the character reference and listing immutable traits (same beanie/sunglasses/jacket/fur tone/facial structure/body proportions) with “zero identity drift allowed.”  
Specify a single unbroken side-scrolling tracking shot with explicit constraints (smooth lateral glide left→right, no cuts/jumps, full body always visible from the side) to stabilize camera motion.  
Choreograph motion with timestamped beats (e.g., at 8.8s slow, turn, kneel, reach to grass; camera gently pushes in and holds) to control action and framing.  
Drive coherent scene changes by scripting a timestamped environment progression (e.g., 0.0s misty forest → 10.0s coastal cliff) while keeping the character continuous.  
If Seedance censors or produces low-dynamics output, animate the keyframes in an alternate generator (e.g., Grok Imagine) instead of forcing Seedance.  
Extend the finished video by prompting a continuation that starts from the last pose and adds new actions plus dialogue with explicit lip-sync requirements.  
Do final compositing in After Effects for time-ramping and adding sound/music after generation.

translations.es:
Utiliza dos fotogramas clave (inicio y fin) como referencias estrictas: establece el fotograma de apertura como referencia absoluta de la identidad del personaje y el fotograma de cierre como la composición final exacta a mantener al final.  
Evita la deriva de identidad priorizando explícitamente la referencia del personaje y enumerando rasgos inmutables (mismo gorro/gafas de sol/chaqueta/tono de piel/estructura facial/proporciones corporales) con “cero deriva de identidad permitida.”  
Especifica un único plano de seguimiento lateral sin interrupciones con restricciones explícitas (deslizamiento lateral suave de izquierda a derecha, sin cortes/saltos, cuerpo completo siempre visible de lado) para estabilizar el movimiento de la cámara.  
Coreografía el movimiento con ritmos marcados por tiempo (por ejemplo, a los 8.8s, girar lentamente, arrodillarse, alcanzar el césped; la cámara se acerca suavemente y se mantiene) para controlar la acción y el encuadre.  
Impulsa cambios de escena coherentes escribiendo una progresión de entorno con marcas de tiempo (por ejemplo, 0.0s bosque brumoso → 10.0s acantilado costero) mientras mantienes la continuidad del personaje.  
Si Seedance censura o produce una salida de baja dinámica, anima los fotogramas clave en un generador alternativo (por ejemplo, Grok Imagine) en lugar de forzar Seedance.  
Extiende el video terminado solicitando una continuación que comience desde la última pose y agregue nuevas acciones más diálogo con requisitos explícitos de sincronización labial.  
Realiza la composición final en After Effects para ajustar el tiempo y agregar sonido/música después de la generación.
translations.fr:
Utilisez deux images clés (début et fin) comme références strictes : définissez l'image d'ouverture comme référence absolue de l'identité du personnage et l'image de clôture comme la composition finale exacte à maintenir à la fin.  
Empêchez la dérive d'identité en priorisant explicitement la référence du personnage et en listant les traits immuables (même bonnet/lunettes de soleil/veste/teinte de fourrure/structure faciale/proportions corporelles) avec "aucune dérive d'identité autorisée."  
Spécifiez un plan de suivi latéral unique et ininterrompu avec des contraintes explicites (glissement latéral fluide gauche→droite, pas de coupures/sauts, corps entier toujours visible de côté) pour stabiliser le mouvement de la caméra.  
Chorégraphiez le mouvement avec des temps marqués (par exemple, à 8,8s ralentir, tourner, s'agenouiller, atteindre l'herbe ; la caméra pousse doucement et maintient) pour contrôler l'action et le cadrage.  
Conduisez des changements de scène cohérents en scénarisant une progression environnementale marquée par des temps (par exemple, 0,0s forêt brumeuse → 10,0s falaise côtière) tout en gardant le personnage continu.  
Si Seedance censure ou produit un résultat à faible dynamique, animez les images clés dans un générateur alternatif (par exemple, Grok Imagine) au lieu de forcer Seedance.  
Prolongez la vidéo terminée en incitant une continuation qui commence à partir de la dernière pose et ajoute de nouvelles actions plus un dialogue avec des exigences explicites de synchronisation labiale.  
Faites le compositing final dans After Effects pour le time-ramping et l'ajout de son/musique après la génération.
translations.ja:
---
2つのキーフレーム（開始と終了）を厳密な参照として使用します。オープニングフレームを絶対的なキャラクターアイデンティティの参照として設定し、クロージングフレームを最終的な構成として設定します。  
アイデンティティのドリフトを防ぐために、キャラクターの参照を明示的に優先し、変更不可能な特性（同じビーニー/サングラス/ジャケット/毛の色調/顔の構造/体の比率）を「アイデンティティのドリフトは許可されない」とリストします。  
カメラの動きを安定させるために、単一の途切れないサイドスクロールのトラッキングショットを明示的な制約（滑らかな横方向のグライド左→右、カット/ジャンプなし、常に側面から全身が見える）で指定します。  
動作をタイムスタンプ付きのビートで振り付け（例：8.8秒でゆっくりと回転し、ひざまずき、草に手を伸ばす；カメラが優しく寄り、保持する）して、アクションとフレーミングを制御します。  
キャラクターを連続させながら、タイムスタンプ付きの環境の進行をスクリプト化することで、一貫したシーンの変化を促進します（例：0.0秒霧の森→10.0秒海岸の崖）。  
Seedanceが検閲したり、低ダイナミクスの出力を生成した場合は、Seedanceを強制するのではなく、代替のジェネレーター（例：Grok Imagine）でキーフレームをアニメーション化します。  
最後のポーズから始まり、新しいアクションと対話を追加し、明示的なリップシンクの要件を含む継続を促すことで、完成したビデオを拡張します。  
生成後、After Effectsでタイムランピングを行い、音楽/音を追加して最終合成を行います。
---
translations.ko:
---
두 개의 키프레임(시작과 끝)을 엄격한 참조로 사용하세요: 시작 프레임을 절대적인 캐릭터 정체성 참조로 설정하고, 끝 프레임을 마지막에 유지할 정확한 최종 구성으로 설정하세요.  
캐릭터 참조를 명시적으로 우선시하고 변경 불가능한 특성(같은 비니/선글라스/재킷/털 색조/얼굴 구조/신체 비율)을 나열하여 "정체성 드리프트 허용 안 됨"을 통해 정체성 드리프트를 방지하세요.  
카메라 움직임을 안정화하기 위해 명시적인 제약 조건(부드러운 측면 이동 왼쪽→오른쪽, 컷/점프 없음, 항상 측면에서 전체 몸체가 보임)이 있는 단일 연속 횡스크롤 트래킹 샷을 지정하세요.  
동작과 구도를 제어하기 위해 타임스탬프가 있는 비트(예: 8.8초에 천천히 돌고, 무릎을 꿇고, 풀을 향해 손을 뻗음; 카메라가 부드럽게 밀고 유지함)로 동작을 안무하세요.  
캐릭터를 연속적으로 유지하면서 타임스탬프가 있는 환경 진행(예: 0.0초 안개 낀 숲 → 10.0초 해안 절벽)을 스크립팅하여 일관된 장면 변화를 유도하세요.  
Seedance가 검열하거나 낮은 동적 출력을 생성하는 경우, Seedance를 강제하지 말고 대체 생성기(예: Grok Imagine)에서 키프레임을 애니메이션화하세요.  
마지막 포즈에서 시작하여 새로운 동작과 대사를 추가하고 명시적인 립싱크 요구 사항을 포함하여 연속성을 프롬프트하여 완성된 비디오를 확장하세요.  
생성 후 시간 램핑 및 사운드/음악 추가를 위해 After Effects에서 최종 합성을 수행하세요.
---
translations.pt-BR:
Use duas keyframes (início e fim) como referências estritas: defina o quadro de abertura como referência absoluta de identidade do personagem e o quadro de fechamento como a composição final exata a ser mantida no final.  
Evite a deriva de identidade priorizando explicitamente a referência do personagem e listando traços imutáveis (mesmo gorro/óculos de sol/jaqueta/tom de pele/estrutura facial/proporções corporais) com “zero deriva de identidade permitida.”  
Especifique uma única tomada de rastreamento lateral contínua com restrições explícitas (deslizamento lateral suave da esquerda para a direita, sem cortes/pulos, corpo inteiro sempre visível de lado) para estabilizar o movimento da câmera.  
Coreografe o movimento com batidas cronometradas (por exemplo, aos 8,8s, virar devagar, ajoelhar, alcançar a grama; câmera avança suavemente e mantém) para controlar a ação e o enquadramento.  
Conduza mudanças coerentes de cena roteirizando uma progressão de ambiente cronometrada (por exemplo, 0,0s floresta enevoada → 10,0s penhasco costeiro) enquanto mantém a continuidade do personagem.  
Se o Seedance censurar ou produzir saída de baixa dinâmica, anime os keyframes em um gerador alternativo (por exemplo, Grok Imagine) em vez de forçar o Seedance.  
Estenda o vídeo finalizado solicitando uma continuação que comece a partir da última pose e adicione novas ações mais diálogo com requisitos explícitos de sincronização labial.  
Faça a composição final no After Effects para ajuste de tempo e adição de som/música após a geração.
translations.zh-CN:
使用两个关键帧（开始和结束）作为严格参考：将开场帧设定为绝对角色身份参考，将结束帧设定为最终构图的精确定格。  
通过明确优先考虑角色参考并列出不可变特征（同样的帽子/太阳镜/夹克/毛色/面部结构/身体比例）来防止身份漂移，并注明“零身份漂移允许”。  
指定一个不间断的侧滚动跟踪镜头，具有明确的约束条件（平滑的横向滑动从左到右，无剪切/跳跃，始终从侧面可见全身）以稳定相机运动。  
通过时间戳节拍编排动作（例如，在8.8秒时缓慢转身、跪下、伸手触草；相机轻轻推进并保持）来控制动作和构图。  
通过编写时间戳的环境进程脚本来驱动连贯的场景变化（例如，0.0秒雾蒙蒙的森林→10.0秒海岸悬崖），同时保持角色的连续性。  
如果Seedance审查或产生低动态输出，则在另一个生成器（例如，Grok Imagine）中动画化关键帧，而不是强制使用Seedance。  
通过提示从最后一个姿势开始并添加新动作和对话（带有明确的口型同步要求）来扩展完成的视频。  
在After Effects中进行最终合成，以在生成后进行时间调整和添加声音/音乐。
